يزدريان (form VIII)
# يَزْدَرِيَانِ (yazdariyāni) /jaz.da.ri.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# يُزْدَرَيَانِ (yuzdarayāni) /juz.da.ra.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
